verifications.claim: The 2026 tax filing deadline for most Americans is April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'File on: April 15, 2026'; R7: 'The end of the 2026 tax season for most individual taxpayers is April 15, 2026'; R3: 'The April 15 tax deadline is here'; R9: 'The IRS tax filing deadline for 2026 is April 15'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state April 15, 2026, as the federal tax filing deadline for calendar year filers/most taxpayers.

verifications.claim: Taxpayers can file an automatic extension to October 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'automatic extension until Oct. 15'; R5: 'automatic 6-month extension of time to file'; R7: 'additional six months to October 15, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm automatic extension to October 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: Taxpayers must still pay any estimated taxes owed by April 15, 2026 to avoid penalties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'You should pay any owed taxes by your original due date to avoid possible penalties'; R7: 'Taxes owed must still be paid by April 15, 2026, to avoid penalties'; R3: 'you must send a payment to cover it or face penalties'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state taxes owed (including estimated) must be paid by April 15 to avoid penalties; 'estimated taxes' is precisely covered as part of owed taxes.

verifications.claim: April 15, 2026 is the deadline to file 2025 federal tax returns.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Calendar year filers (most common) File on: April 15, 2026'; R7: '2026 tax season for ... 2025'; R8: 'April 15, 2026 2025 Personal Income Tax returns due'
verifications.reasoning: Direct match: April 15, 2026, for 2025 tax year returns.

verifications.claim: April 15, 2026 is the deadline to pay any tax due.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Taxes are still owed by April 15'; R5: 'pay any owed taxes by your original due date'; R7: 'Taxes owed must still be paid by April 15, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm payment due by original deadline of April 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: April 15, 2026 is the last day to file for an automatic 6-month extension.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'file Form 4868 ... by the original due date of your return'; R3: 'must do so before April 15'
verifications.reasoning: Extension request must be filed by original due date, April 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: October 15, 2026 is the extended deadline to submit tax returns.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'automatic extension until Oct. 15'; R7: 'six months to October 15, 2026, to submit a complete return'; R8: 'October 15, 2026 Extended due date for 2025 Personal Income Tax returns'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statement of extended deadline as October 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: May 1, 2026 is the special deadline for residents in disaster-prone areas.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'until May 1, 2026, to file various federal ... tax returns ... affected by severe storms ... in the State of Washington'; 'taxpayers now have until May 1, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: R1 supports May 1, 2026, extension for specific disaster-affected areas in Washington, but claim's 'disaster-prone areas' is broader/less precise than the exact disaster declaration.

verifications.claim: Form 4868 can be used to request an extension.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'file Form 4868, Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File'; R5: 'You must file Form 4868, Application for Automatic Extension of Time To File'
verifications.reasoning: Directly named as the form for automatic extension.

verifications.claim: Form 4868 only extends time to file, not time to pay.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'an extension to file is not an extension to pay taxes'; R5: 'An extension of time to file is not an extension of time to pay'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states extension via Form 4868 (context) only for filing, not payment.

verifications.claim: Special rules for extensions apply to military members stationed outside the U.S.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Members of the military Special rules may apply if you served or are serving in the Armed Forces'; R6: 'If you’re stationed outside the United States or Puerto Rico on May 1, you have until July 1'; 'Military Deployment Outside the United States'
verifications.reasoning: Sources detail special filing extensions for military stationed/serving outside U.S.
